From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>, Lukas Meyer <lukas.meyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>, Talia Benson <talia.benson@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwoodinference.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>, Renee Sullivan <renee.sullivan@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, Aug 12, 2024 at 9:14 AM
Subject: Standard Demo Deck v1 — final review + approvals by EOD Fri

Hi all —

We’re at the “lock v1” stage for the Redwood Standard Demo Deck. Goal is to finalize by EOD Fri so Enablement can roll out next week.

Please review the latest deck + add comments in Drive (or reply in-thread with Approve / Approve w/ changes).

Drive folder (single source of truth):
https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1RWD-Demo-Standard-v1

Deck (Working):
https://drive.google.com/file/d/1RWD-Deck-Standard-Demo-Working

Speaker notes / talk track (for reference):
https://drive.google.com/document/d/1RWD-TalkTrack-StandardDemo

What I need from you:
1) Confirm claims are accurate + “safe to say” (no hard numbers, ranges only)
2) Confirm persona flow makes sense (Platform Eng / ML Eng / Security)
3) Confirm we’re not missing any must-have slide for enterprise (SLA, isolation, audit logs, residency)

What’s already incorporated since last dry run:
- Removed explicit $/1M token examples; replaced w/ “cost levers” framing
- Added a “Reliability by design: fallback + graceful degradation” slide
- Tightened the Hosted → Dedicated → Private progression (less whiplash)

Attachments:
- Redwood Standard Demo Deck v1.0 — Reviewer Copy (PDF)

Thanks,
Soojin

—
Soojin Lee
Director, Product Marketing
Redwood Inference



From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>, Lukas Meyer <lukas.meyer@redwoodinference.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>, Talia Benson <talia.benson@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwoodinference.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>, Renee Sullivan <renee.sullivan@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, Aug 12, 2024 at 12:02 PM
Subject: Re: Standard Demo Deck v1 — final review + approvals by EOD Fri

Reviewed. Overall flow is strong and will reduce “SE heroics.”

A few SE-specific change requests:
- Slide “Smart routing” (currently slide 9): please add a one-liner that policies can be scoped per route / per tenant (prospects ask if it’s global).
- Slide “Observability” (cost + latency): call out that per-route breakdown works for streaming too (common skepticism).
- Add a small “If live demo fails” presenter note on the fallback slide (e.g., pivot to screenshots + canned outputs, then show dashboards).

Otherwise: Approve w/ changes above.

Markus

—
Markus Klein
Director, Solutions Engineering
Redwood Inference



From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>, Lukas Meyer <lukas.meyer@redwoodinference.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>, Talia Benson <talia.benson@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwoodinference.com>, Renee Sullivan <renee.sullivan@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, Aug 13, 2024 at 8:41 AM
Subject: Re: Standard Demo Deck v1 — final review + approvals by EOD Fri

Thanks Soojin — security review notes below.

Approve w/ changes:
1) “Data retention” language: on the security slide, please avoid “we don’t retain data.” Better: “Retention is configurable by plan; demo tenant uses short retention and is sanitized.” (We’ve been burned on absolute statements.)
2) Add mention of audit logs + export (even if the demo only shows the UI, prospects want proof we have it).
3) If we include “SOC 2” anywhere, specify “SOC 2 Type II” only if we’re comfortable; otherwise just “SOC 2 (available on request)” and keep it in the verbal talk track.

If you want, I can drop exact text suggestions into the speaker notes section.

Naomi

—
Naomi Feldman
Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

Looks good for EMEA with one gap:

- Can we add a small callout on the deployment flexibility slide re: region options / data residency? Even a “Private deployments can be region-pinned / customer VPC” note helps.

Otherwise approve.

Lukas

Date: Wed, Aug 14, 2024 at 7:23 AM
Subject: Re: Standard Demo Deck v1 — final review + approvals by EOD Fri

Approve w/ one request:

- Please tighten the first 3 slides (problem framing) — AEs need to hit the “why now” in under 2 minutes. If you can reduce text and add a single “what customers care about” bullet list (latency, unit cost, reliability, deployment flexibility), that would be huge.

Also +1 to keeping pricing numbers out. We can do ranges verbally and push specifics to follow-up.

Stephanie

—
Stephanie Nguyen
VP Sales, North America
Redwood Inference

Date: Wed, Aug 14, 2024 at 11:39 AM
Subject: Re: Standard Demo Deck v1 — final review + approvals by EOD Fri

Adding Marketing review notes.

Approve w/ changes:
- Any benchmark/proof language must stay qualitative unless we can cite internally. Recommend “consistent low-latency inference” + “cost controls like batching/caching/quantization” rather than numbers.
- Please add a final slide “Next steps: evaluation plan” (even if it’s 3 bullets). Helps Marketing/Sales keep post-demo motion consistent.
- Visual: the routing diagram is still a little dense — can we simplify arrows/labels? (If not, ok for v1.)

Thanks,
Camila

—
Camila Reyes
VP Marketing
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Standard Demo Deck v1 — final review + approvals by EOD Fri

Jordan — pulling you in for final sign-off.

We got approvals w/ minor edits from Sales, SE, Security, Marketing. I’m applying the edits tonight:
- Remove absolute retention phrasing; add audit log language (Naomi)
- Add data residency note for Private + region-pinning (Lukas)
- Tighten “why now” intro slides (Stephanie)
- Add “Next steps / eval plan” close (Camila)
- Add a couple presenter notes for live-demo failure pivot (Markus)

If you’re good with this direction, please reply “Approved” and we’ll lock v1 tomorrow.

Latest working link (same file):
https://drive.google.com/file/d/1RWD-Deck-Standard-Demo-Working

Soojin

Approved.

Two CRO notes for v1 (not blockers):
1) Make sure the “Hosted → Dedicated → Private” progression is framed as customer choice / maturity, not a forced upsell.
2) Keep a clear line between what we show live vs what we describe (esp. around audits/retention). If it’s not in the demo tenant UI, it needs to be in speaker notes as “available in enterprise / shown in security package.”

Nice work getting this to a consistent narrative.

Jordan

—
Jordan Blake
Chief Revenue Officer
Redwood Inference
